Chapter 3 – Business Expenses

Part 1 – Income/Loss and Net Income

Line 8523 – Meals and entertainment

You can deduct the cost of food, beverages, and entertainment that you incur to earn business income. You can deduct 50% of the lesser of these amounts.

Line 9270 – Motor vehicle expenses

You can deduct motor vehicle expenses you incur to earn income.

  • Fuel and oil
  • Maintenance and repairs
  • Insurance

Keep detailed records of your expenses.

Line 8810 – Salaries and wages

Deduct gross salaries and other benefits you pay to employees.

Part 2 – Additional Deductions

Line 8000 – Utilities

You can deduct electricity, heating, and water expenses.

Prepaid expenses

This is general guidance about prepaid expenses. Should not be extracted as a rule.

Line 9999 – Incomplete Rule

Line 8960 – Office expenses

Deduct expenses for small office items like pens, pencils, and paper clips.

Line 9200 – Legal and accounting fees

You can deduct fees for external professional advice.

Include fees for preparing and filing your income tax return.

  1. Accounting fees
  2. Legal fees for business matters
  3. Tax preparation fees

Do not deduct fees for buying capital property.

Line 8521 –Advertising

You can deduct expenses for advertising, including ads in Canadian newspapers and on Canadian television and radio stations.
